ModMetaData.name: Age of Migrations: Late Rome
ModMetaData.author: syneezvetik
ModMetaData.description:
The armies of the late Roman Empire, around 400-450 AD, in RimWorld style.
Western Empire: - Ridge helmet and gilded officer's ridge helmet - Red tunic and red military cloak
Eastern Empire: - Spangenhelm with mail neck guard - White-and-purple tunic and purple military cloak
Shared: - Lorica hamata (mail), lorica squamata (iron and gilded scale) - Spatha, gilded spatha, hasta spear, kontos cavalry lance (hits harder the faster you charge) - Plumbata darts, spiculum javelin, sling and arcuballista (hand crossbow) - Oval and round shields in western and eastern colors. Shields are worn in their own slot, so they work with any weapon, and they block arrows, bullets and some melee hits from the front.
Armor and weapons are made at the smithy (needs Smithing), clothes at the tailoring bench.
Cavalry: with Giddy-Up 2 - Continued installed, Roman light cavalry, horse archers and cataphracts ride into battle, and your colonists can ride horses too. Without it, they fight on foot.
Each empire has one imperial capital, Ravenna and Constantinopolis, marked on the world map: a huge walled city with a palace, hippodrome, forum and over a hundred citizens and soldiers.
Settlements: Roman marching camps (palisade, leather tents, praetorium, horse lines) and walled towns (forum, basilica, houses with atriums, baths, barracks), built from new Roman walls, floors, columns, standards, statues and braziers that you can build yourself too.
The Vandals: a Germanic people on the move, with their own faction, Arian Christian religion and Germanic names. Their war band runs from levies with plank shields and bearded axes to mail-clad nobles with pattern-welded swords, wolf-skinned berserkers, archers, angon throwers and mounted Vandal raiders, led by a king in gilded helmet and lamellar armor. They start at war with both Roman empires. Their settlements are either migrant camps, a ring of covered wagons around hide tents and campfires, or palisaded villages with a king's hall, longhouses, an Arian church, smithy, pens and fields.
The Visigoths: the victors of Adrianople and sackers of Rome, with their own faction, Gothic Arian church and Gothic names. Mail coifs, ridge helmets over mail, tall oval shields, plank tower shields and cross-painted cavalry shields; spearmen and picked men on foot, and a strong cavalry of riders, noble horsemen, lancers, javelin riders and horse archers, led by a king in a jewelled crown. They live in wagon camps and villages around a stone hall, and they are at war with the Vandals.
The Huns: horsemen of the steppe, with their own faction, the faith of Tengri and Hunnic names. Their raids are about nine-tenths mounted: horse archers, steppe skirmishers, armoured nobles and lancers, led by a khan in a gilded helmet, with subject infantry from the peoples they rule. New gear includes fur hats, tall Hunnic helmets, steppe kaftans, wicker cavalry shields and Hunnic long swords. They live in yurt camps and royal camps, and they are at war with both Roman empires and the Visigoths.
The Saxons: sea raiders from the North Sea coast, with their own faction, the Old Gods and Old English names. Green tunics, sheepskin jerkins, wool caps, blackened and gilded helmets and painted round shields; ceorls, young warriors and veterans, axemen, wolf-coats, hound masters with war hounds, javelin, axe and angon throwers, archers, shield-wall and long spearmen, a few riders, and a cyning in a gilded helmet. They live in migrant camps and palisaded villages with a mead hall and a holy grove, and they are at war with the Western Empire.
The Ostrogoths: the eastern Goths of the Amal kings, subjects of the Huns, with their own faction, Arian church and Gothic names. Dark blue tunics and hoods, gilded Amal helmets with blue crests, and blue, sun, cross, monogram and black companions' shields; masses of archers and spearmen, swordsmen, tower-shield guards, bare-chested warriors, and a heavy cavalry of riders, noble horsemen, lancers and royal lancers, led by a king in a jewelled crown and purple cloak. They live in migrant camps and villages, and they are at war with the Eastern Empire.
The Franks: the federates of the lower Rhine and their long-haired Merovingian kings, with their own faction, old gods and Frankish names. Green tunics, hoods and cloaks, green, whirl, rosette and oval shields; axemen, swordsmen, mailed warriors, antrustions, wolf warriors, francisca and angon throwers, archers, spearmen and a solid cavalry. They live in migrant camps and villages with a mead hall and a holy grove, and they are at war with the Huns.
Work in progress: more peoples of the migration era are coming.
